{{Quote|On behalf of my sisters, I, Mother Augwynne, welcome you to the Singing Mountain clan.|[[Augwynne Djo]]|<ref name="TCoPL" />}}
The '''Singing Mountain Clan Village''' was a [[city/Legends|village]] built at the foot of the [[Singing Mountain (Dathomir)/Legends|Singing Mountain]] on the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]] [[Planet/Legends|world]] of [[Dathomir/Legends|Dathomir]]. Along with the [[Singing Mountain Clan Stronghold|fortress]] in the heights of the mountain, it was the home of the [[Singing Mountain Clan]].

==Description==
{{Quote|I have sworn my oath, and will not waiver. I will defend my home to the death.|A [[Unidentified Singing Mountain Clan Sentinel|Singing Mountain Clan sentinel]]|<ref name="SWGTCG:SMS">{{SWGTCG|set=The Shadow Syndicate|cardname=Singing Mountain Sentinel}}</ref>}}
[[File:Singing_Mountain_pathway.jpg|thumb|left|250px|The beginning of the mountain pathway linking the village with the fortress]]
The Singing Mountain Clan Village was the main settlement of the [[Singing Mountain Clan]], a major clan of [[Witches of Dathomir]]. The village was built across the lower slopes of the [[Singing Mountain (Dathomir)/Legends|Singing Mountain]], a volcanic mountain located on the planet [[Dathomir/Legends|Dathomir]]. The village formed the primary residential and agricultural center of the community. Its dwellings and work areas were arranged along natural terraces in the mountainside, interspersed with orchards and open grounds used for gathering, training, and domestic activity.<ref name="TCoPL" /> The Singing Mountain Clan Village was decorated with carved stones, with some of them maintained constantly in levitation by [[Telekinesis/Legends|telekinesis]].<ref name="SWG:SMCV">{{SWGcite|exp=AED|type=location|Singing Mountain Clan Village|Dathomir}}</ref>

The village functioned in direct relationship to the [[Singing Mountain Clan Stronghold|fortress]], which dominated the landscape from its higher position on the flank of the mountain. Stone steps carved directly into the dark basalt of the mountain linked the village and the fortress. Together, the two formed a unified settlement distributed along the natural gradient of the mountainside. The village served as the living base of the population, while the fortress acted as the defensive, ceremonial, and political center.<ref name="TCoPL" />

==History==
{{Quote|I come here often. It is my second home in the galaxy, but it is the first home of my heart.|[[Tenel Ka Djo]], to [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]]|<ref name="YJKSA">''[[Young Jedi Knights: Shadow Academy]]''</ref>}}
In [[31 BBY/Legends|31 BBY]], the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] [[Mission to Dathomir (Post–Naboo crisis)|thwarted]] a plot of the [[Nightsisters/Legends|Nightsisters]] to used an [[Infinity Gate|ancient superweapon]] against the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]]. Due to the proximity between the [[Star Temple]] containing this weapon and the Singing Mountain Clan Stronghold, the Singing Mountain Clan later became the guardian of the Star Temple. Following the rise of the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Jax Pavan]] visited the Singing Mountain Clan Village in order to obtain the support of [[Clan mother/Legends|Clan Mother]] [[Augwynne Djo]] to access the Star Temple.<ref name="TLJ">[[The Last Jedi (novel)|''The Last Jedi'']]</ref>

[[File:Singing Mountain Village 2.jpg|thumb|right|250px|The village during the Galactic Civil War]]
In [[8 ABY/Legends|8 ABY]], during the [[Hunt for Zsinj|campaign]] against [[Warlord of the Empire|Imperial Warlord]] [[Zsinj]], the heir of the [[Hapes Consortium/Legends|Hapes Consortium]] [[Isolder]] and the heroes of the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker]], [[Leia Organa Solo/Legends|Leia Organa]], [[Han Solo/Legends|Han Solo]] and [[Chewbacca/Legends|Chewbacca]] inadvertently arrived on the planet Dathomir. The offworlders took shelter in the Singing Mountain Clan village and eventually allied with the witches against the evil Nightsisters. The Nightsisters later attacked the fortress to capture the offworlders but they were repelled by the Singing Mountain Clan witches and their new allies. The Singing Mountain Clan and the New Republic eventually [[Battle of Dathomir (Hunt for Zsinj)|defeated]] both the Nightsisters and [[Zsinj's Empire]].<ref name="TCoPL" />

Years later, Luke Skywalker returned to the Singing Mountain Clan Village to request support of the clan in searching information about the Nightsisters and the [[Second Imperium]]'s [[Shadow Academy]].<ref name="YJKSA" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Singing Mountain Clan Village first appeared in the [[1994]] novel ''[[The Courtship of Princess Leia]]'', written by [[Dave Wolverton]].<ref name="TCoPL" /> It later appeared as a playable location in the [[2003]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] [[Star Wars Galaxies|''Star Wars Galaxies: An Empire Divided'']], a [[Wikipedia:Massively multiplayer online role-playing game|massively multiplayer online roleplaying game]] developed by [[Sony]] Online Entertainment and published by [[LucasArts]],<ref name="SWG:SMCV" /> prior to its closure on [[December 15]], [[2011]].<ref name="Shutdown">{{SonyCite|url=playerinfo|text=IMPORTANT INFORMATION ABOUT ''STAR WARS'' GALAXIES™}}</ref>
